name: dsh-plugin-jiyibi
description: 记一笔 — meaning-marking popup for DeepSeek Harness: like e-book marginalia, jot in your own words what a moment meant to you. Each mark snapshots the moment (immune to context compaction) into a searchable personal ledger that outlives any session. The AI keeps the log; you keep what mattered. A tool for thought, never written for you, over an in-memory Connection RPC channel + a plugin-owned durable file — never the session log.
